 Emma Watson is enjoying a rare night out!
 The 36-year-old Harry Potter actress made a quick dash into Chateau Marmont for Giorgio Armani ‘s exclusive 2026 Academy Museum Gala after-party on Saturday night (October 17) in Los Angeles.
 For the party, Emma wore a black coat over a sparkling and lace black dress with a high slit.
 12 
 It’s unclear if Emma attended the actual Academy Museum Gala as she did not walk the red carpet and wasn’t seen in any of the inside photos .
 Emma ‘s appearance at the party comes after she also joined tons of other stars at opening night party for George Lucas ‘ Lucas Museum of Narrative Art.
 12 
 12 
 Over the summer, the Little Women actress joined Prince William as they took part in a Business Forum for The Royal Foundation’s United for Wildlife in London. While speaking at the event, Emma recounted a story about a time during her Harry Potter days where she thought her privacy had been invaded…but it was just a bit of a mix-up!
